description: Verify a fixed-representation continuation-ordering separation witness using exact binary64 integer arithmetic. Checks a caller-pinned joint-policy-v1 checkpoint, extracts its 147 continuation coefficients, verifies supplied hidden bytes and first-max labels, then checks ideal and conservative binary64-relaxed infeasibility separately. At most 8192 rows, 1 MiB checkpoint and 8 MiB request; bounded workers with cooperative deadlines. The SHA values bind supplied bytes, not authenticated provenance: hidden features and teacher programs are not reexecuted. No file access, weight edit, witness search, task-value improvement, whole-network impossibility or production eligibility.

hidden_f64_le_hex.description:
Exactly 49 little-endian F64 values as 784 lowercase hex characters.
Coordinates must be finite, bounded by one, with an exact final +1 bias.

multiplier_f64_le_hex.description: One finite, nonnegative little-endian F64; zero supplies no separation.

target_action.description: Fixed action IDs: 1 WAIT, 2 READ, 3 REPAIR.

teacher_q_f64_le_hex.description: Six finite supplied scores. Selection must be the first legal maximum.

original_witness_record_sha256.description: Binds the upstream record identity; that record is not read by this tool.

checkpoint_json.description:
Original, declared joint-policy-v1 JSON, at most 1 MiB. The first three
affine output rows and biases are the center; no replacement center input.

expected_checkpoint_sha256.description: SHA256 of the exact UTF-8 checkpoint_json bytes, supplied by the caller.

expected_witness_sha256.description: Digest of the documented binary witness encoding, checked independently.

rows.description: Complete supplied witness, at most 8192 rows and 8 MiB canonical request.

semantics.description: Exact declaration required; the verifier does not probe hardware semantics.

name: weight_continuation_certificate
title: Verify an Exact Continuation Ordering Certificate
